events.label: Spike ordered for Nevada
events.quote: The spike was ordered on May 5, 1869 by Railroad Commissioner and candidate for Governor of the new State of Nevada, Mr. F.A. Tritle.

events.label: Monday, 12:47 p.m.
events.quote: The time was 12:47 p.m., Monday, May 10, 1869.

events.label: Hewes donates the Golden Spike to Stanford
events.quote: In 1892, Hewes donated his extensive rare art collection, including the Golden Spike, to the museum of newly built Leland Stanford Junior University in Palo Alto, California.

events.label: Christies Auction House to sell the Arizona spike
events.quote: In January 2023, Christies Auction House was commissioned to sell the Arizona Gold and Silver Spike for the Museum of the city of New York.
